# AIR CHECK - net list and pin map (ACC-1 rev C, v1.2)

## Power tree

```
1S LiPo 4000 mAh --J2--+--J3--> FireBeetle BAT (JST PH)
                       `------> LED1 common anode (VBAT)

USB-C (FireBeetle) --> CN3165 charger, 540 mA --> VBAT
VBAT / USB --> TPS62A02 buck --> +3V3 (always on, FireBeetle)

+3V3 --[SW1 TPS22918, CT 4.7 nF, GPIO2]--> +3V3_SEN6X --> SEN63C, R11/R12 pull-ups
+3V3 --[SW2 TPS22918, CT 1 nF,   GPIO3]--> +3V3_SENS  --> SGP40 breakout, R6/R7 pull-ups
+3V3 ---------------------------------->  ESP32-C6, button pull-up
VIN (USB 5 V) --68k--+--100k-- GND        USB_SENSE on GPIO18
VBAT --1M--+--1M-- GND  (on the FireBeetle)  BAT_ADC on GPIO0
```

## Rails

| rail | min | nom | max | source |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| VUSB | 4.75 V | 5.00 V | 5.25 V | USB-C VBUS on the FireBeetle (its VIN pin) |
| VBAT | 3.20 V | 3.80 V | 4.20 V | 1S LiPo, protected |
| +3V3 | 3.20 V | 3.30 V | 3.40 V | FireBeetle TPS62A02 buck, always on; 100 % duty below ~3.4 V VBAT |
| +3V3_SEN6X | 3.20 V | 3.30 V | 3.40 V | +3V3 behind load switch SW1 |
| +3V3_SENS | 3.20 V | 3.30 V | 3.40 V | +3V3 behind load switch SW2 |
| GND | 0.00 V | 0.00 V | 0.00 V | system ground |

## GPIO map (ESP32-C6 on the DFRobot FireBeetle 2)

| GPIO | header label | signal | dir | LP pad | note |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | (on board) | BAT_ADC | analog in | yes | FireBeetle R15/R16 1M/1M VBAT divider, ADC1 channel 0 - not on a header |
| 1 | 1 | BTN | in | yes | wake source, active low |
| 2 | 2 | EN_SEN6X | out | yes | held LOW in sleep |
| 3 | 3 | EN_SENS | out | yes | held LOW in sleep, pulsed per VOC sample |
| 6 | 6 | SENS_SDA | bidir | yes | LP_I2C SDA - a fixed IO_MUX pad on the C6, not remappable |
| 7 | 7 | SENS_SCL | bidir | yes | LP_I2C SCL - a fixed IO_MUX pad on the C6, not remappable |
| 18 | 18 | USB_SENSE | in | no | VIN / 1.68, high while USB is connected |
| 19 | SDA | SEN_SDA | bidir | no | HP I2C, released to input when SW1 is off |
| 20 | SCL | SEN_SCL | bidir | no | HP I2C, released to input when SW1 is off |
| 21 | 21 | LED_R | out | no | sink, active low |
| 22 | 22 | LED_G | out | no | sink, active low |
| 23 | 23 | LED_B | out | no | sink, active low |

## I2C buses

One bus per switched rail, each with its pull-ups on the rail it serves, 100 kHz:

| address | device |
|---|---|
| 0x59 | SGP40 (LP_I2C, GPIO6/7, pull-ups to +3V3_SENS) |
| 0x6B | SEN63C (HP I2C, GPIO19/20, pull-ups to +3V3_SEN6X) |

The Adafruit SGP40 breakout has its own 10k pull-ups (to its VIN and to its LDO output) and BSS138 level shifters. They sit on the same switched rail, so they vanish with it; together with R6/R7 the bus sees about 3.2k.
